name: Posterior Shoulder Impingement / Internal Impingement
definition: Contact-related pain between the posterosuperior glenoid and rotator cuff/labral structures, classically occurring in overhead athletes during late cocking.

typical: Posterior shoulder pain in overhead position

investigations.principle: MRI/MR arthrography is used when structural labral or cuff injury is suspected.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, labral, tendon, cartilage, ligament or occult injury assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Persistent structural symptoms may require sports-shoulder specialist assessment.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Amsa-Snayu mechanical pain phenotype may be documented only in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Contact-related pain between the posterosuperior glenoid and rotator cuff/labral structures, classically occurring in overhead athletes during late cocking.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, unreduced dislocation, major trauma, rapidly progressive weakness, suspected tendon rupture, infection or other listed red flags.
